text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home after going out with Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-chan!
Remember how we talked about that livestream before?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since then, my listeners have just kept growing,
and Maya's channel is super popular now!♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Checking the stream archive on my smartphone, it was indeed—

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener A: Maya-chin, you're always so cute!
Listener B: Maya-chin is the best, love you! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passionate comments like these lined the screen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See?
Maya's popularity is skyrocketing too☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And guess what! Maya wants to show everyone
a whole new side of Maya on the next stream!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Still, what should we do~?
Trainer-chan, got any good ideas?
choice_data_list: Why not let them watch our practice?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"That's it!
As expected of my Trainer-chan, sharp as always!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If everyone sees Maya working hard,
they'll love Maya even more, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And・so☆ Since Trainer-chan was the one who brought it up, how about you take the photos~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If I get popular streaming,
won't I end up getting all the attention in races too~?"
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's get a shot of you singing!
Got it. Let's get a shot of you running!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Taking off right away onto the stage☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Landing right into everyone's hearts! ☆
Mayachin Channel is about to begin~♪

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener C: UOOOOOOH!!
Listener D: Maya-chin's full of energy today too~ ☆
Listener E: Where are you right now~?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪
Thanks for all the comments, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna show everyone
our live performance rehearsal!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And the one filming it is none other than...
Maya's trusty ally, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They're the one who trains Maya
and gives Maya lots of compliments! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener F: Can't wait for the live performance~
Listener G: I wanna be her Trainer!!
Listener H: Seriously so jealous."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop it, you guys~♪ Well then, Mayachin's live show starts now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One-two☆ Sparkle-sparkle☆
Maya-chin☆ So-sexy☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And we finish cute at the very end!

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener I: Sooo cuuuute!!
Listener J: The singing and dancing were the best!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aw, shucks... maybe I am that great♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If Maya wins the race, Maya'll show you a live Maya-chin concert at the Winning Live☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So everyone, please cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Taking off right away onto the track☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Landing right into everyone's hearts! ☆
Mayachin Channel is about to begin~♪

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener C: Wahooooo!!
Listener D: Thanks for the landing! ☆
Listener E: No way, in a tracksuit!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪
Thanks for all the comments, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gonna show everyone
Maya doing her training!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And the one filming it is none other than...
Maya's trusty ally, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They're the one who trains Maya
and gives Maya lots of compliments! ♪

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener F: Good luck with training~
Listener G: I'm on your side too, Maya-chin!
Listener H: Trainer, swap places with meee!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop it, you guys~♪ Well then, let's start training!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Goal! How was Maya's running, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener I: So freakin' fast!
Listener J: That was seriously cool!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aw, shucks... maybe I am that great♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this,
I'm gonna show everyone a super cool Maya today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No blinking allowed, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since she was full of motivation,
I took advantage of the opportunity and had her complete more training than usual."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah~!
More listeners joined♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
There are more comments
than any stream so far!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪
Seeing Trainer-chan smiling makes Maya so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm just gonna get more and more popular at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding high on her momentum,
Mayano Top Gun dove even deeper into video streaming.
